card.name: Linking words inside regulatory phrase lists
card.fires_on: Commas, "and" or "or" that join items in a fixed legal or label phrase, such as "particulate matter and discoloration" or "unfair, unjustly discriminatory or deceptive". Also "the" before "ingredient statement".
